# Validation failures

<small>Source: [`R/errors.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/r-dataexcept/blob/main/R/errors.R) · Help: `?validation_error`</small>

`validation_error()` reports a value that fails a rule: the payload is
wrong, so it is classified as permanent and not retryable for the same
unchanged input.

## Usage

```r
validation_error(field, value, message = NULL, parent = NULL, call = NULL)
```

## Arguments

`field`
:   Name of the field that failed validation.

`value`
:   The offending value. Stored as given; rendered in the default
    message with [`deparse()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/deparse.html).

`message`
:   A message to use instead of the default.

`parent`
:   The condition that caused this one, or `NULL`.

`call`
:   The call to report, or `NULL`.

## Value

A condition of class `dataexcept_validation_error`.

## Examples

```r
check_age <- function(age) {
  if (age < 0) stop(validation_error("age", age))
  age
}
tryCatch(check_age(-1), dataexcept_validation_error = function(e) e$field)
```
